At `mncs-language` `a0255f8`, `mncs-embed::Session` exposes `call` and
`call_json`. The same crate exports `mncs_session_call_batch` only through its
unsafe C ABI. Doctor's safe Rust runtime cannot use that ABI without creating
a second handle/lifetime/serialization boundary.
